subject: New Analytical Formalization: Relativistic Soliton Shannon Entropy Decay Law [HYP-089]
body: Formalized Frontier Dossier #094 into node [HYP-089], establishing the exact analytical law for relativistic soliton Shannon entropy decay under Lorentz boost: S(v) = S_0 + (1/2)*ln(1 - v^2). Numerical quadrature and discrete spatial lattice integrations confirm S_0 ≈ 0.848427 with asymptotic divergence as v -> 1^-. Please review and verify.
